status.title: System status
status.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.

admin.account_disabled: The account is disabled, so this is not possible.
admin.address_required: Your address could not be determined. Reload the page.
admin.already_activated: This account is already activated. If the password is forgotten, issue a reset token.
admin.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
admin.identity_already_set: This user's national ID is already enrolled.
admin.identity_check_limit: Today's identity check limit is reached. Another admin can check, or try again tomorrow.
admin.identity_check_required: Run a successful identity check first (valid for 10 minutes).
admin.identity_in_person: No national ID is enrolled. Identify the person in person with their ID card and enrol it.
admin.import_changed: The file changed since the preview. Preview it again.
admin.import_invalid: The file has invalid rows. Fix them and upload again. No account was created.
admin.import_too_large: The file is too large (up to 1 MB).
admin.invalid_phone: The phone number is invalid. Enter an 8-digit Mongolian number.
admin.lockout_clear_limit: This user's lockout was cleared too many times today.
admin.no_pending_deletion: This account has no pending deletion, or 30 days have passed.
admin.no_phone: This user has no registered phone. Use the in-person QR.
admin.phone_reveal_limit: Today's phone reveal limit (20) is reached.
admin.reset_needs_other_admin: You enrolled this user's national ID, so another admin must do the reset.
admin.reset_required: The account was locked for security reasons. It reopens only after an identity check and a password reset.
admin.session_invalid: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
admin.sms_failed: The SMS could not be sent. The token is still valid — issue again or use the in-person QR.
admin.sms_unavailable: SMS is not set up yet. Use the in-person QR.
admin.status_change_not_allowed: This status change is not possible.

auth.activation_invalid: The activation code is invalid or has expired. Ask an admin for a new one.
auth.forbidden: You don't have access to this.
auth.locked: Too many failed attempts. Wait a while and try again.
auth.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
auth.session_invalid: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

consent.not_allowed: You cannot give consent for this profile.
consent.required: Give the required consents to continue.
consent.version_outdated: The consent text was updated. Read the new text and consent again.

error.internal: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, contact the system administrator.

me.no_recent_admin_action: No admin action on your account in the last 30 days.

password.contains_username: Don't include your username in the password.
password.too_long: The password is too long (up to 128 characters).
password.too_short: The password needs at least 10 characters.
password.too_weak: The password is too easy to guess. Use a longer phrase of several words.

problem.columns: Wrong columns (username, display_name; optionally phone, role).
problem.display_name: Display name is empty, too long or contains forbidden characters.
problem.encoding: The file is not UTF-8. Save it from Excel as "CSV UTF-8".
problem.too_large: The file is too large (up to 1 MB).

login.title: Admin sign-in
login.expired: Your session ended (15 min idle or 8 hours). Sign in again.
login.invalid: Wrong username, password or authenticator code.

new.title: Register a user
new.hint: Register only after identifying the person (in person or by video call). No password is set — the user activates the account.
new.national_id: National ID (from the ID card, e.g. УБ90010101; optional)

detail.deletion: The user asked to delete the account. It is erased on {date}.

activation.title: Activation
activation.hint: The user scans this QR with the phone that has the app and sets their own password. Valid 15 minutes, shown once.
activation.sms: Send SMS to the registered phone

qr.expired: The QR expired. Create a new one.
qr.notice_not_sent: No notice reached the user's registered phone. Tell them another way.
qr.once: The QR is shown only once — after hiding it you cannot see it again.
qr.hidden: The QR is hidden. Create a new one if needed (the old one stops working).

card.title: LabTrack MN — login card
card.note: This card holds no password. Never tell anyone your password.

identity.hint: First call the registered phone BACK, then ask the person for their national ID. The system only says whether it matches.
identity.match: It matches. You may reset within 10 minutes.
identity.no_match: It does not match. Do not reset unless the person is verified.
identity.enrol_title: Enrol national ID (in person, from the ID card)
identity.match_expired: The identity check's 10 minutes are over. Check again.

reset.title: Password reset
reset.hint: The old password stops working at once and every device is signed out. The user sets a new password.
reset.needs_check: Run a successful identity check above first.
reset.confirm: You are about to reset {name}'s password. The old password stops working and every device is signed out.

status_change.title: Change status
status_change.confirm: You are about to set {name} to "{status}". Every device is signed out.

unlock.title: Clear login lockout
unlock.hint: Clears the temporary lockout from failed logins (the account status is unchanged).

phone.title: Reveal phone number
phone.confirm: This is recorded in the audit log (up to 20 a day). Use it only to call back.

deletion.cancel_hint: Only at the user's request. The account comes back locked and needs an identity check and a password reset.
deletion.cancelled: Deletion cancelled. The account is locked.
deletion.confirm: You are about to cancel {name}'s deletion. Only at the user's request.

import.title: Bulk registration from CSV
import.hint: Columns: username, display_name, phone (optional), role (user/doctor). The file is never stored, only checked in memory. National IDs are enrolled in person later.
import.confirm: You are about to register {count} users. This cannot be undone.
import.stale: The file changed. Preview it again.
import.caption: Rows ready to register

security.admin_token_self_use: An admin tried to use a token they issued (refused)
security.admin_network_activation: QR activated from the issuing admin's network
security.purge_failed: A deleted account could not be erased
